shortDescription: Russian banks' net profit fell 0.7% month-on-month to 440 billion roubles ($5.22 billion) in August, the central bank said on Tuesday.The central bank also said corporate lending rose 1.4% in August compared to July and 13.2% year-on-year.($1 = 84.3455 roubles)

The central bank also said corporate lending rose 1.4% in August compared to July and 13.2% year-on-year.
